items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: My mother was working for the baker, B.C. Fronsang(?).

ctx.x: My stepfather was Chris Columbel(?), who was a Cajun, a Creole who'd come from out the swamp-land. Handsome. He became a baker. He was a baker. My mother was working for the baker, B.C. Fronsang(?). She was a housekeeper.
